d: From returning to Mumbai Indians as an IPL-winning captain to leaving after three difficult seasons, Hardik Pandya's second stint has taken a very different turn from what anyone expected. His Indian Premier League trade to Punjab Kings before IPL 2027 brings in questions about captaincy, dressing-room dynamics and whether Pandya can rediscover the freedom that made him such a dangerous all-rounder at Gujarat Titans. Rupha Ramani looks at why the Mumbai reunion failed, what Shreyas Iyer's captaincy means for Hardik and how Ricky Ponting could help him rebuild his IPL career.
